170.315(b) (10) Electronic Health Information (EHI) Export in MDFlow™ EHR V 8.0

The patient Electronic Health Information (EHI) export contains data stored in the patient's chart in
the SQL database. The C-CDA or Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture or CSV Text file or
PDF File is used for health information exchange.

      We support multiple file formats for export patient EHI data.

      The primary patient’s EHI export format is CCDA.

      Our system can also accommodate our clients’ special and customized requests of the EHI
       export. The proprietary file format CSV Text file and/or PDF File are used in these cases.

      Our system can export single patient’s EHI or a group of patients’ EHI.

      The Zip file is used to compress the data if the file size is large.
key_claims: Export contains data stored in the patient's chart in the SQL database
CSV and PDF available for special and customized requests
Can export single patient or group of patients
ZIP compression used for large files

Product Name and Version : MDFlow EHR 8.1

The patient EHI export contains data from the patient's chart. Multiple file formats are used to store this information.


ZIP is an archive file format.


C-CDA or Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture is a file format used for health information exchange.


The export file itself is a zip file. It contains zip files of C-CDAs


Information for each patient encounter is available C-CDA format in zip archive.
key_claims: Export contains data from the patient's chart
C-CDA is the health information exchange format
Export file is a ZIP containing ZIP files of C-CDAs
Each patient encounter has a C-CDA in the ZIP archive
